name: Port Autonome de Dakar (PAD)
verdict: Senegal's state-owned autonomous port authority ('société nationale'), a named sponsor of ASC Ville de Dakar's 2026 BAL campaign.

why.text: Senegalese security forces killed at least 65 protesters and arrested a further 2,000 people during the 2021–2024 crackdown on protests, according to Amnesty International. The Port Autonome de Dakar, one of the club's sponsors, is 100% owned by the Senegalese state.
why.messageLine: Amnesty International says Senegalese security forces killed at least 65 protesters between 2021 and 2024.

note: Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Propose 'serious' per METHOD.md — the Senegalese state (100% shareholder) controls the sponsor, and Senegal's 2021–2024 protest crackdown is documented by Amnesty International and Human Rights Watch. For the maintainers to weigh: the September 2026 France/Renault decision found protest-policing findings alone don't make a record; Senegal's documented deaths (65+ killed, most by firearms) and mass arrests (2,000) go beyond the excessive-force findings that decision turned on.
